# 1. CLEAR ENVIRONMENT & SET PROJECT INFO
```{r CLEAR-ENVIRONMENT}
#------------------------ 1.1 CLEAN ENVIRONMENT ------------------------#
rm(list = ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, all.names = TRUE)) # Clear wrkspace objects
invisible(gc())  # Garbage collection to free memory

# Global options for consistent behavior
options(
  max.print              = 50000, # Cap console output
  scipen                 = 999,   # Avoid scientific notation, 0 if yes
  stringsAsFactors       = FALSE, # Keep strings as character
  dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, # Suppress dplyr's messages
  digits                 = 4      # Number of digits to print
  )

set.seed(1234)
#------------------------ 1.2 PROJECT INFO ------------------------# 
info <- list(
  Title             = "SPLIT GFP TRAP ANALYSIS",
  R_Version         = R.version$version.string,
  Working_Directory = getwd(),
  Timestamp         = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  )

separator <- paste0("\n", strrep("=", 80), "\n")

cat(separator)
cat("PROJECT:", info$Title, "\n")
cat(separator)

cat("R Version:", info$R_Version, "\n")
cat("Working Directory:", info$Working_Directory, "\n")
cat("Timestamp:", info$Timestamp, "\n")
cat(separator)

info$renv_active <- renv::project()
cat("renv Project:", info$renv_active, "\n")

info$Git_Commit <- system("git rev-parse --short HEAD", intern = TRUE)
cat("Git Commit:", info$Git_Commit, "\n")

if (interactive()) {
  message("Run sessionInfo() for reproducibility.")
}
```

# 8. RUN DESeq
```{r DESeq-run, message = FALSE}
#------------------------ SETUP DESEQ2 ------------------------#
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = ImvHvUM,
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ Groups)

## Prefilter low-count genes
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]
## UM reference
dds$Groups <- relevel(dds$Groups, ref = "UM")
cat("Counts loaded:", nrow(dds), "genes x", ncol(dds), "samples\n")

#------------------------ RUN DESEQ2 ------------------------#
dds <- DESeq(dds)

#------------------------ SAVE OBJECT ------------------------#
## Save DESeq object
```

## 13. PCA & PLOT
```{r PCA}
#------------------------ PCA PLOT ------------------------#
pca_data <- DESeq2::plotPCA(vsd, 
                           intgroup = c("Groups", "Condition"), 
                           returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar"))

# Plot
p_pca <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Groups, shape = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 4.5, stroke = 1.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = "Tissue") +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = name),                 
                  box.padding = 0.35, 
                  max.overlaps = Inf,  # Show all labels
                  size = 3.5, 
                  segment.color = "red",
                  segment.size = 0.3,
                  bg.color = "white", 
                  bg.r = 0.1) +
  labs(title = "TRAP-seq Sample Clustering (Variance-Stabilized Counts)",
       subtitle = paste("PC1:", round(percentVar[1],1), "% variance |",
                       "PC2:", round(percentVar[2],1), "% variance"),
       caption = "Groups: UM (uninfected mesophyll), IM (infected mesophyll), H (haustoria)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(p_pca)
```

## 14. LFC SHRINKAGE + ARRANGEMENT + CLEAN
```{r DESeq-results-lfc, message=FALSE}
#------------------------ CONTRASTS ------------------------#
contrasts <- list(
  H_vs_UM  = list(coef = "Groups_H_vs_UM",  contrast = c("Groups", "H", "UM")),
  IM_vs_UM = list(coef = "Groups_IM_vs_UM", contrast = c("Groups", "IM", "UM"))
)
#------------------------ Raw Results ------------------------#
#technically already did this
res_raw_list <- lapply(contrasts, function(x) {
  results(dds, contrast = x$contrast)
})
#------------------------ RUN RESULTS  ------------------------#
res_raw_list <- lapply(contrasts, function(x) {
  results(dds, contrast = x$contrast)
})
#------------------------ LFC Shrinkage  ------------------------#
# function to safely run lfcShrink with fallback
safe_lfcShrink <- function(dds, coef_name, contrast_vec) {
  tryCatch({
    lfcShrink(dds, coef = coef_name, type = "apeglm")
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste0("apeglm failed for ", coef_name, ", using normal: ", e$message))
    lfcShrink(dds, contrast = contrast_vec, type = "normal")
  })
}
#------------------------ RUN Shrinkage  ------------------------#
lfc_list <- lapply(contrasts, function(x) {
  safe_lfcShrink(dds, x$coef, x$contrast)
})

#------------------------ SAVE OBJECT ------------------------#
# Save DESeq object
#saveRDS(lfc_list, file.path("~/Desktop/Lab/Haust_TRAP_proj/TRAP_Results", "deseq_shrunken_lfc.rds"))


#------------------------ CLEAN RESULTS  ------------------------#
#This section uses raw padj and shrunk LFC
clean_res <- function(raw_res, shrink_res) {
  df <- as.data.frame(shrink_res)
  df$padj <- raw_res$padj
  df$pvalue <- raw_res$pvalue
  df$TAIR <- rownames(df)

  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    arrange(padj)
}
#apply
res_list <- mapply(clean_res, res_raw_list, lfc_list, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

#------------------------ SAVE OBJECT ------------------------#
#saveRDS(res_list, file.path("~/Desktop/Lab/Haust_TRAP_proj/TRAP_Results", "deseq_clean_results.rds"))
```


```{r SPLIT DEGS, message=FALSE}
#------------------------ SPLIT DEGs ------------------------#
annotate_DEGs <- function(df, lfc_thresh, pad) {
  df %>%
   mutate(
      DEG = padj < pad & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_thresh,
      direction = case_when(
        DEG & log2FoldChange >= lfc_thresh  ~ "UP",
        DEG & log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thresh ~ "DOWN",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )}
res_list <- lapply(res_list, annotate_DEGs, lfc_thresh, pad)

#------------------------ ADD ANNOTATION ------------------------#
add_annotations <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      symbol = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "SYMBOL",
                      keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first"),
      entrez = mapIds(org.At.tair.db, keys = TAIR, column = "ENTREZID",
                      keytype = "TAIR", multiVals = "first")
    )}
res_list <- lapply(res_list, add_annotations)

#------------------------ EXTRACT DEG SUBSETS ------------------------#
deg_list <- lapply(res_list, function(df) df %>% filter(DEG))
deg_split <- lapply(deg_list, function(df) split(df, df$direction))

#------------------------ SUMMARY TABLE ------------------------#
summary_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(names(res_list), function(name) {
  df <- res_list[[name]]
  tibble(
    contrast = name,
    n_DEG  = sum(df$DEG),
    up     = sum(df$direction == "UP"),
    down   = sum(df$direction == "DOWN")
  )
}))

summary_tbl
```


```{r MA PLOTS, message=FALSE}
#########################  MA PLOTS #########################
plot_DEGs_MA <- function(lfc_obj, df, title) {
  plotMA(lfc_obj, ylim = c(-5,5), main = title)
  
  sig <- df$DEG
  
  points(
    log2(lfc_obj$baseMean[sig] + 1),
    lfc_obj$log2FoldChange[sig],
    col = "red",
    pch = 16,
    cex = 0.6
  )
  
  invisible(NULL)
}

purrr::pwalk(
  list(lfc_list, res_list, names(res_list)),
  plot_DEGs_MA
)
```

## 15. TOP 100 GENES & HEATMAP
```{r deg-heatmap}
set.seed(123)
######################### TOP 100 DEGs HEATMAP #########################
topN <- 100  # Number of genes to display

# Rank DEGs by |LFC|
top_DE_IM <- deg_list$IM_vs_UM %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) #%>%
 # slice_head(n = topN)

top_DE_H <- deg_list$H_vs_UM %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange)))#%>%
#  slice_head(n = topN)

# Define shared gene sets
top_shared_genes <- intersect(top_DE_IM$TAIR, top_DE_H$TAIR)
all_shared_genes <- intersect(deg_list$IM_vs_UM$TAIR,
                             deg_list$H_vs_UM$TAIR)

cat("Top shared DEGs:", length(top_shared_genes), "\n")
cat("All shared DEGs:", length(all_shared_genes), "\n")

# Keep only genes present in normalized counts
top_shared_genes <- intersect(top_shared_genes, rownames(norm_counts))

######################### HEATMAP #########################

if(length(top_shared_genes) > 0){

  deg_mat <- norm_counts[top_shared_genes, ]

  ######################### ROW ANNOTATION (FIXED) #########################
# Include direction from BOTH contrasts
  direction_df <- deg_list$IM_vs_UM %>%
    select(TAIR, direction_IM = direction) %>%
    left_join(
      deg_list$H_vs_UM %>%
        select(TAIR, direction_H = direction),
      by = "TAIR"
    ) %>%
    filter(TAIR %in% top_shared_genes) %>%
    column_to_rownames("TAIR")

 ######################### COLUMN ANNOTATION #########################
  ann_col <- data.frame(Groups = sample_info$Groups)
  rownames(ann_col) <- colnames(deg_mat)
  ######################### COLORS #########################
  ann_colors <- list(
    Groups = c(IM = "hotpink", H = "blue", UM = "black"),
    direction_IM = c(UP = "#e41a1c", DOWN = "#377eb8", NS = "grey"),
    direction_H  = c(UP = "#e41a1c", DOWN = "#377eb8", NS = "grey")
  )


  ######################### PLOT #########################
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    deg_mat,
    scale = "row",
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "RdYlBu")))(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
    clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
    clustering_method = "complete",
    annotation_col = ann_col,
    annotation_row = direction_df,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    show_rownames = ifelse(length(top_shared_genes) < 30, TRUE, FALSE),
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    main = paste0("Top Shared DEGs (n=", 
                  length(top_shared_genes), ")"),
    fontsize_row = 8,
    filename = file.path(graphics_dir, "heatmap_top_shared_DEGs.png"),
    width = 12, height = 10
  )
} else {
  cat("No shared DEGs found in norm_counts.\n")
}

######################### SHARED / UNIQUE ANALYSIS #########################

# Use DEG-filtered tables directly
deg_IM <- deg_list$IM_vs_UM
deg_H  <- deg_list$H_vs_UM

# Gene sets
shared_genes <- intersect(deg_IM$TAIR, deg_H$TAIR)
unique_IM <- setdiff(deg_IM$TAIR, deg_H$TAIR)
unique_H  <- setdiff(deg_H$TAIR, deg_IM$TAIR)

######################### SHARED DEG TABLE #########################

deg_shared <- deg_IM %>%
  select(TAIR, log2FoldChange_IM = log2FoldChange, padj_IM = padj) %>%
  inner_join(
    deg_H %>%
      select(TAIR, log2FoldChange_H = log2FoldChange, padj_H = padj),
    by = "TAIR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    avg_lfc = (log2FoldChange_IM + log2FoldChange_H) / 2,
    concordance = case_when(
      log2FoldChange_IM > 0 & log2FoldChange_H > 0 ~ "UP_UP",
      log2FoldChange_IM < 0 & log2FoldChange_H < 0 ~ "DOWN_DOWN",
      TRUE ~ "DISCORDANT"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_lfc)))
######################### SUMMARY TABLE #########################

summary_tbl <- tibble(
  Category = c("IM_vs_UM", "H_vs_UM", "Shared", "Unique_IM", "Unique_H"),
  n_genes  = c(nrow(deg_IM), nrow(deg_H),
               length(shared_genes),
               length(unique_IM),
               length(unique_H))
) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_of_IM = round(100 * n_genes / nrow(deg_IM), 1),
    percent_of_H  = round(100 * n_genes / nrow(deg_H), 1)
  )

print(summary_tbl)

######################### EXPORT #########################

deg_workbook <- list(
  IM_vs_UM    = deg_IM %>% arrange(padj),
  H_vs_UM     = deg_H %>% arrange(padj),
  Shared_DEGs = deg_shared,
  Unique_IM   = deg_IM %>% filter(TAIR %in% unique_IM),
  Unique_H    = deg_H %>% filter(TAIR %in% unique_H)
)

# writexl::write_xlsx(deg_workbook,
#   file.path(tables_dir, "DEG_summary.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
# Flatten DEG splits into clean Entrez ID lists
entrez_list <- lapply(deg_split, function(contrast_list) {
  list(
    UP   = unique(contrast_list$UP$entrez[!is.na(contrast_list$UP$entrez)]),
    DOWN = unique(contrast_list$DOWN$entrez[!is.na(contrast_list$DOWN$entrez)])
  )
})

#########################  SPLIT INTO UP / DOWN #########################

entrez_up <- list(
  IM_UP = entrez_list$IM_vs_UM$UP,
  H_UP  = entrez_list$H_vs_UM$UP
)

entrez_down <- list(
  IM_DOWN = entrez_list$IM_vs_UM$DOWN,
  H_DOWN  = entrez_list$H_vs_UM$DOWN
)

#########################  GO BP ENRICHMENT (COMPARECLUSTER) #########################

go_up <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = entrez_up,
  fun = "enrichGO",
  OrgDb = org.At.tair.db,
  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = pad,
  qvalueCutoff = pad,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

go_down <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = entrez_down,
  fun = "enrichGO",

  keyType = "ENTREZID",
  ont = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = pad,
  qvalueCutoff = pad,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500
)

go_up<- simplify(go_up)
go_down<-simplify(go_down)

go_up<- pairwise_termsim(go_up)
go_down<-pairwise_termsim(go_down)

#########################  DOTPLOTS #########################

p_go_up <- dotplot(go_up, showCategory = 12, font.size = 11, label_format = 60) +
  ggtitle("GO (ALL) Terms: UP-regulated (IM vs UM, H vs UM)")

p_go_down <- dotplot(go_down, showCategory = 12, font.size = 11, label_format = 60) +
```

```{r heatmap of top 10 green and red}
# column annotation (samples)

  Groups = metadata$Groups,
  col = list(

      "UM" = "black",
      "IM" = "hotpink",
      "H"  = "blue"
    )
  )

  Group = top_genes_labeled$group,
  col = list(
    Group = c(
      "H_Up"   = "#1b9e77",
      "H_Down" = "#DFFF00",
      "IM_Up"  = "#A52A2A",
      "IM_Down"= "#BF40BF"
    )
  )
)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("blue", "white", "red")
)

top10 <- Heatmap(
  mat_scaled,
  name = "Z-score",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = col_ha,
  left_annotation = row_ha,
  
  cluster_rows = FALSE,   # preserve bio grouping
  cluster_columns = FALSE, # preserve UM, IM, H
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  
  row_split = top_genes_labeled$group,
  column_split = metadata$Groups,
  column_title = "Sample: UM, IM, H",
  row_title = "Gene Groups: Up & Down"
)
pdf(file.path(graphics_dir, "TOP10_Heatmap.pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 10)

draw(top10, heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right")

dev.off()
```

```{r}
process_KEGG <- function(kk, label) {
  if (is.null(kk)) return(NULL)
  
  df <- as.data.frame(kk)
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df$Group <- label
  return(df)
}

H_up_kegg    <- process_KEGG(kegg_upH, "H Up")
H_down_kegg  <- process_KEGG(kegg_downH, "H Down")
IM_up_kegg   <- process_KEGG(kegg_upIM, "IM Up")
IM_down_kegg <- process_KEGG(kegg_downIM, "IM Down")


combined_KEGG <- bind_rows(
  H_up_kegg,
  H_down_kegg,
  IM_up_kegg,
  IM_down_kegg
)
top_KEGG <- combined_KEGG %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  slice_min(p.adjust, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(top_KEGG, aes(x = Group,
                     y = reorder(Description, -log10(p.adjust)))) +
  geom_point(aes(size = Count, color = -log10(p.adjust))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "KEGG Pathway Comparison Across Conditions",
    x = "",
    y = "KEGG Pathways",
    size = "Gene Count",
    color = "-log10(adj p-value)"
  )

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "KEGG.png"), width=12, height=10)
```

```{r}
# Plot bubble barplot

fam_plot <- ggplot(family_summary,
                   aes(x = fct_reorder(Family, gene_count),
                       y = gene_count)) +
  
  # Bars = number of genes per family
  geom_col(fill = "grey85") +
  
  # Overlay bubbles = expression + significance
  geom_point(aes(size = median_log10_padj,
                 color = median_logFC)) +
  
  # Flip axes for readability
  coord_flip() +
  
  # Color gradient: blue = down, white = neutral, red = up
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "purple",   # lower induction
    mid = "white",
    high = "hotpink",  # stronger induction
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Transporter Family-Level Response in Haustoriated Cells",
    x = "Transporter Family",
    y = "Number of Genes",
    color = "Median log2FC",
    size = "Median -log10(padj)"
  ) +
  
  # Theme adjustments
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# Display plot
print(fam_plot)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Combine Up and Down transporter families
H_up_summary <- H_up_transporters %>%
  distinct(id, Family, logFC_x, log10_padj) %>%
  mutate(Direction = "Up") %>%
  group_by(Family, Direction) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_count = n(),
    median_logFC = median(logFC_x),
    median_log10_padj = median(log10_padj),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

H_down_summary <- H_down_transporters %>%
  distinct(id, Family, logFC_x, log10_padj) %>%
  mutate(Direction = "Down") %>%
  group_by(Family, Direction) %>%
  summarise(
    gene_count = n(),
    median_logFC = median(logFC_x),
    median_log10_padj = median(log10_padj),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

combined_summary <- bind_rows(H_up_summary, H_down_summary)
combined_summary <- combined_summary %>% filter(gene_count >= 2)

# Make Direction a factor so Up is on top
combined_summary$Direction <- factor(combined_summary$Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))
```

```{r}
summarize_families <- function(df, direction){
  df %>%
    distinct(id, Family, logFC_x, log10_padj) %>%
    mutate(Direction = direction) %>%
    group_by(Family, Direction) %>%
    summarise(
      gene_count = n(),
      median_logFC = median(logFC_x),
      median_log10_padj = median(log10_padj),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

H_up_summary <- summarize_families(H_up_transporters, "Up")
H_down_summary <- summarize_families(H_down_transporters, "Down")
combined_summary <- bind_rows(H_up_summary, H_down_summary)
combined_summary$Direction <- factor(combined_summary$Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))

family_order <- combined_summary %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(total_genes = sum(gene_count)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_genes)) %>%
  pull(Family)



combined_summary$Family <- factor(combined_summary$Family, levels = family_order)
ggplot(combined_summary,
       aes(x = gene_count, y = Family)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey85") +
  geom_point(aes(size = median_log10_padj, color = median_logFC)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "purple", mid = "white", high = "hotpink", midpoint = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~Direction, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2), limits = c(0,10)) +  # set ticks from 0-10 by 2
  labs(
    title = "Transporter Family-Level Response in Haustoriated Cells",
    x = "Number of Genes",
    y = "Transporter Family",
    color = "Median log2FC",
    size = "Median -log10(padj)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )
ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "H_combined_families.png"),
      width = 10,
       height = 6,
       dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# TRANSPORTER FAMILY PLOT

# Load packages
library(forcats)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

# Load transporter gene data
transporter_genes <- read_excel("../HvIM/Data_Repository/6_transporter_df.xlsx") %>%
  rename(id = TAIR) %>%
  mutate(id = trimws(as.character(id)))

green_H_up <- green_H_up %>% mutate(id = trimws(as.character(id)))
green_H_down <- green_H_down %>% mutate(id = trimws(as.character(id)))

# Extract transporters
H_up_transporters <- green_H_up %>%
  semi_join(transporter_genes, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(transporter_genes, by = "id") %>%
  select(id, logFC_x, padj_x, Family) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC_x)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    log10_padj = -log10(padj_x),
    FC_label = round(logFC_x, 2)
  )

H_down_transporters <- green_H_down %>%
  semi_join(transporter_genes, by = "id") %>%
  left_join(transporter_genes, by = "id") %>%
  select(id, logFC_x, padj_x, Family) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC_x)) %>%
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    log10_padj = -log10(padj_x),
    FC_label = round(logFC_x, 2)
  )

# -----------------------------
# Save outputs
# -----------------------------

ggsave(file.path(graphics_dir, "H_combined_families_function.png"),
       fam_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
